title: the chakras as a map, not a claim (science seat)
hook: the sleeper wakes and climbs, lotus by lotus, to a meeting at the crown
carry: the chakras as a map, not a claim (science seat)
tomorrow: why would a map of the body have letters on its petals?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the chakras as a map, and a week of maps that share one word: wheels, circles, made to be traveled. Today, the traveler sets out.

An elevator in a tall building chimes at every floor, and every time the doors slide open on a different hallway. The old map has a journey like that, only slower. The serpent who slept across the door at the base of the spine has lifted her head. The road is open. And she begins to rise, one lotus at a time, each one turning toward her as she passes, toward a place at the very top that she has never reached.
screen: `A CHIME AT EVERY FLOOR.` → `THE SLEEPER LIFTS HER HEAD.` → `SHE RISES, ONE LOTUS AT A TIME.`

segments.voice: The Sat-Cakra-Nirupana tells the climb center by center. She passes the root, the lotuses above it, the heart with its unstruck sound, the throat, the place between the brows. Each station has its own shape and sound, and the meditator follows her with attention, stop by stop. Then, above them all, at the crown, the text sets a lotus of a thousand petals: Sahasrara. That's where she's going. And when she arrives, she isn't alone. There, the text says, kundalini, Shakti, the Goddess as power, unites with Shiva. So the top of the map isn't a light switching on. It's a meeting. That's the line worth repeating tonight. If it sounds familiar, it should: the Sri Yantra's point held the Goddess and Shiva as one. The chakra map tells the same meeting upward, along the body. The science seat has an easy day. A thousand-petaled flower inside the skull? The text isn't asking that. Some readers take the thousand as fullness, more than anyone could count. And the story isn't finished at the summit. The text has one more page, and it comes later in the run.
screen: `THE CLIMB, LOTUS BY LOTUS.` · `SAHASRARA: A THOUSAND PETALS.` · `NOT A SWITCH: A MEETING.` · `THE SAME MEETING AS THE POINT.` · then, large: `AT THE TOP, A MEETING.`

segments.voice: Close your eyes and rest your attention at the base of your spine. With each slow breath, let it climb a little: the belly, the heart, the throat, the brow, the crown. At the top, don't reach for anything; stay there, and let it be a meeting rather than a finish line.
The chakras as a map: a climb, lotus by lotus, to Sahasrara, the thousand-petaled crown, where Shakti and Shiva meet.
screen: `THE CHAKRAS AS A MAP — today's word`.

segments.voice: Your line: the chakras as a map, not a claim. At the top, a meeting, not a switch. Day sixteen forty-six, climbed.

screen: `DAY 1646 COUNTS.` → `THE TANTRAS, FRAMED · 38 OF 42.` → `TOMORROW: WHY LETTERS ON THE PETALS?`

howItsDone: In kundalini meditation as the tantric texts describe it, practitioners move attention upward center by center toward the crown, usually under a teacher's guidance.
